speech.jaymoskingdoms.druid.tells.0: You carry the sprig. Then sit, and hear what the wood once told me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.druid.tells.1: One dead for good waits beside their body. Bring it under old wood, trunks round it and leaves over it, before ten days are out.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.druid.tells.2: Speak the rite over it and the wood lends them a new body. Not their old blood: the wood chooses that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.druid.knows: You have the rite already. Old wood, ten days, and the body at your feet.
